name: loginwa-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for the LoginWA WhatsApp API: devices, OTP, send, and broadcast.
long_description:
Hosted WhatsApp API gateway. No VPS required. This unofficial stdio server wraps the public LoginWA HTTP API so agents can list devices, send OTP, send messages, and run broadcast campaigns.

Pair devices in the browser at https://loginwa.com/welcome. Create an API key in the dashboard and paste it into LOGINWA_API_KEY. LOGINWA_BASE_URL is optional.

The process starts and advertises tools even when LOGINWA_API_KEY is unset. Tool calls fail until a key is provided.

LOGINWA_API_KEY.title: LOGINWA_API_KEY
LOGINWA_API_KEY.description: Required. Dashboard API key secret. Create a key after registering, then paste it here. Never commit the value.

LOGINWA_BASE_URL.title: LOGINWA_BASE_URL
LOGINWA_BASE_URL.description: Optional. API base URL. Leave empty to use the LoginWA production API.

tools.name: device_status
tools.description: List devices or fetch one by id. Reports offline honestly and points to /welcome for pairing.

tools.name: otp_verify
tools.description: Verify an OTP code against a session from otp_start.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp text or media message from a connected device.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Get details for a broadcast campaign by id.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create a broadcast campaign with an inline contact list.

tools.name: send_campaign
tools.description: Queue a campaign to send. Needs an online device.
